scope: 48 saved shared episodes on 12 old development scenes; descriptive and conditional hindsight accounting only

formula.assumption: Zero potential; hypothetical prefix final verification has no rollback or quality correction. Pending menu is paid. No extra counted work is imputed for verification; this is not a wall-clock model.
formula.selection: Maximum over the actually visited decision states, including root and actual terminal STOP; no unvisited alternatives or actions
formula.quality_property: Since incumbent best is monotone and actual finalization has no rollback, an earlier visited STOP cannot improve returned J; it can preserve or worsen it.

teacher_label_scope.source_semantics: Exact full environment observation digest, then evidence mask of selected action; same route or action id alone is insufficient
teacher_label_scope.checked: 95 exported feedback rows against raw saved actions; null discipline and repeated full-observation/action consistency

records.scope: Observed serialized-input and output equality only; does not establish general solver determinism, safe cache equivalence, or counterfactual rollout effects.

repeat_diagnostics.scope: Within-episode comparisons of selected proposals only; no hypothetical cache or execution performed.
